description: Fourteen lines and a cut corner

participation.context: Cut the corner and left the fourteen lines as they stood.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You cut the blotted corner off with your father's glover's paring-knife. Fourteen lines were on the sheet. In the last four, forsworn comes three times. The Golding stayed under Gib.

title: Cut the blot off and kept forsworn three times

participation.context: Wrote the two entries and did not correct the page.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the commonplace line for the morning

story.body: You set down "rheum; a rheumatic morning; the King hath a cold." Under it you noted the repeated word, and you did not correct the page.

relations.note: the commonplace line for the morning
called himself well, and then named the lost morning

story.body: You said a small ailment had commanded the morning, that you had answered the stair by saying you were well, and that Titus at two was not the loss. You stopped.

relations.note: called himself well, and then named the lost morning

title: Said a small ailment commanded the morning
